content:
I'm trying to implement something like this #Is there code for X? > Coq's inversion but with with branches, e.g.:

inversion h with | nil => tac1... | cons => tac2...

Currently, clicking on tac1 shows the proof state of the generated goal nil. However, I see that cases has managed to show that same proof state when the cursor is also on anywhere in | nil => . How do I expand the syntax positions of my goals so that they encompass those parts of the branches in the syntax? I'm struggling to pinpoint the part of Lean.Elab.Tactic.Induction that does this, and I haven't been able to do it by sprinkling withRefs around.
